impact.text: Permanent consumption of one vault slot

precondition_sources.text: The target vault holds an ERC-20 token balance that is not exactly zero, such as a 1-wei dust residual.

intent_sources.text: unregisterVault() must not be blockable by a trivial permissionless dust transfer; validation should be accounting-based rather than a raw balance check.
